name: agent-memory
title_zh: 开工前先翻共享记忆库的搭档
tagline_zh: 每次新任务都像失忆重启？它让你和团队共享一份长期记忆，开工前自动调取相关上下文，少重复问、少翻旧聊天记录。
tagline_en: Stop starting every task from zero. It reads and writes a shared memory store, so you and your team pick up where.
desc_en: Read and write the shared long-term memory store. Use before starting a task that
why_zh: 把记忆从个人 prompt 里挪到共享仓库，读写分离，任务间自动衔接。不是缓存，是能跨会话。
why_en: Moves memory out of one-off prompts into a shared, structured store—read before acting, write after. Built for continuity across.
limit_zh: 只负责读写共享记忆，不替你决定该记什么。需要你或上层流程先定义好记忆的 schema 和写入时机。
limit_en: Only reads/writes the shared store—doesn't decide what to remember. Requires a predefined schema or write triggers; without one, it stores raw text.
title_en: Read-write shared long-term memory before tasks
